rna_support.retinal_homeobox_caveat: CRX and OTX2 were less frequent in Muller glia than in other retinal cells, but were elevated in donor LGS3.
rna_support.exact_match_caveat: NKX6-1 and NOTO were not detected in Muller-glia RNA; their database matches should be interpreted as generic homeobox-family similarity.

technical_bias_screen.interpretation: No evidence that residual Tn5 sequence bias dominates the full no-bias model attribution patterns.

cautions: CRX/OTX and generic homeobox patterns may represent shared retinal grammar, cell-state signal, or contamination rather than Muller-glia-specific regulation.
Database motif names identify sequence families and do not establish which paralog is active.
This is one seed and one chromosome fold; reproducibility across seeds and biological donors remains required.
decision: Use the negative-sampling-ratio-1 model as the provisional primary candidate for seed-reproducibility and donor-sensitivity testing. Differential accessibility remains blocked.
